title: Can the two blocks overlap?
hook: Two useful blocks may overlap more than you expect.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Answer immutable range minimum with overlapping power-of-two blocks because minimum is idempotent.

misconception: Overlapping blocks always double-count and are invalid.
objective: Answer immutable range minimum with overlapping power-of-two blocks because minimum is idempotent.

claims.text: Minimum is unchanged when a covered value appears twice. The comparison case deliberately replaces minimum with sum: using the same overlapping blocks then double-counts, so that query rule does not transfer to every operation.
